extraction_source: local files: index.html, src/index.css, tailwind.config.ts, src/pages/Dashboard.tsx

tone_signals: dashboard subheader: 'Resumen de salud conversacional · vista ejecutiva'
section labels are concise and analytical: KPI Bar, Volume Chart, Sentiment Distribution, Alert Indicators
no emoji, no exclamations, no consumer-friendly verbosity

colors.primary_role: single-anchor brand color — appears as ring, sidebar-primary, chart-line, accent-foreground emphasis
colors.secondary_role: functional sentiment colors only — positive (green), negative (red). NOT decorative.
forbidden: saturated brand blues (compete with violet identity)
warm orange/red as primary (Sense's red is reserved for negative sentiment)
gradient violet→fucsia or any dual-accent decorative gradient
yellow/amber accents (no warning role established in app)

typography.mono_font_suggestion: JetBrains Mono (not in app, but coherent for landing metadata/labels)
typography.pairing_descriptor: Single-font system. DM Sans across display and body. App ships with optical sizing axis (9..40) and tabular nums via feature settings cv02/cv03/cv04/cv11. No serif in product UI.

subjects: social platform glyphs (IG, TW, RD, FB, TikTok)
imagery.composition: clean dashboard, generous negative space, sentiment color coding, dark default with optional light mode
forbidden: cluttered enterprise dashboards (the anti-pattern Sense disrupts)

target_audience.profession: LatAm enterprise marketing leaders — CMOs, brand managers, comms/PR leads, insights teams
pain_points: delayed crisis detection (find out after trending)
US-centric tools that miss LatAm context (Spanish/Portuguese, regional sources)
aspirations: ditch the Monday PDF, get continuous intelligence

differentiators: single violet anchor (vs. competitors' generic enterprise blue)
single-font system DM Sans (vs. competitors' typographic chaos)
dark mode default (vs. legacy SaaS light dashboards)
